project_type: Python FastAPI service with migration repair workflow
build_command: N/A - Python module, no compile step
verification_instructions: Run pytest with specific test file names. Tests must NOT execute actual database operations or shell commands with user input. Use mocks and validation-only checks.
environment_constraints: DO NOT run database operations. DO NOT execute shell commands with unsanitized input. Tests run in memory or with mocks only.
contribution_requirements: Fail closed on uncertain validation. Never silently pass security checks. Log all cleanup attempts to evidence. Verify file existence and hashes, never trust claims.
key_patterns: Existing tests use pytest, pytest_asyncio fixtures, unittest.mock for mocking. Test files follow naming convention test_migration_repair_*.py. All async functions tested with @pytest.mark.asyncio or asyncio_mode=auto.
directory_structure: services/project-ai/app/workflows/migration_repair/ contains core workflow modules (runner, safety, verification, gate, models) and agents/ subdirectory with 13 agent implementations. Tests live in services/project-ai/tests/ with test_migration_repair_*.py naming convention.
